title: CISA Cross-Sector Cybersecurity Performance Goals (CPGs) for IoT/OT Environments

core_goals.description: Maintain accurate, real-time inventory of all connected IoT endpoints, listening ports, and baseline protocol behaviors.
Prevent lateral movement by enforcing VLAN segregation, access control lists (ACLs), and firewall inspection between IoT device tiers.
Establish pre-approved incident containment playbooks for volumetric DDoS, endpoint exhaustion, and spoofing attacks with human oversight.
